summary: Frontend-only mobile regression completed for selected-geometry sketch workflow and FreeCAD-style feature flow. Core requested functionality works, with two notable issues: property-sheet close button is still intermittently untappable on 375x667, and applying horizontal then vertical constraints to the same selected line collapses it to 0 length.

ui_bugs.issue: Close button can be outside viewport and fails with 'Element is outside of the viewport' on 375x667, blocking normal modal dismissal during feature workflow.

ui_bugs.component: Sketch constraint behavior for manual line
ui_bugs.issue: Applying Horizontal then Vertical on the same selected line can collapse line length to 0 mm instead of preserving length while changing orientation.

integration_issues.flow: Base Wall -> Flange -> Hem editing on mobile
integration_issues.issue: Workflow passed only with JS-dispatched close workaround due close-button viewport bug; normal user tap path remains unstable.

issues: Two trash icons appear simultaneously when an element is selected (delete selected + clear), which is visually ambiguous on small screens.

action_items: Fix FeaturePropertySheet close-button positioning/tap area so it is always reachable and tappable at 375x667 without workarounds.
Adjust line-constraint logic so switching between horizontal/vertical does not collapse line length to zero.
Re-run full mobile E2E with only real taps (no JS-dispatch workaround) for Base Wall -> Flange -> Hem flow.
Optional UX cleanup: disambiguate delete-selected vs clear-all trash icons in header.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/canvas.tsx remains oversized (>1500 lines), increasing coupling/regression risk in tool-state + modal-state interactions.
Constraint application uses endpoint projection without preserving prior segment length when changing orthogonal constraint, leading to potential zero-length collapse.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 requested checks passed; 1 partially blocked by mobile modal close bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on 375x667: line selection panel, direct line length edit, constraint button taps, selected labels for line/rectangle/circle, inch toggle, and feature-panel open-properties CTA. Feature attachment flow (Base Wall -> Flange -> Hem) completed only after JS-dispatch close workaround due close button viewport/tappability issue.
rca_of_issue: RCA 1: Property sheet close control intermittently renders outside tappable viewport in mobile web preview, causing Playwright/user click failures with 'outside of viewport'. RCA 2: Sequential horizontal->vertical constraint application reuses endpoint coordinates in a way that can force start/end overlap, producing a 0-length line label. Mitigation: enforce safe modal layout bounds and preserve current segment length when changing orientation constraints.
